papers.abstract: Full-duplex evaluation often emphasizes whether an agent keeps speaking or stops. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.13117v1）：Continue, Adapt, or Yield 在 full-duplex 评测中区分 listener intent（backchannel / collaboration / interruption）与 speaker 行为，引入 Duplex Cue 评测 in-turn adaptation——把'边听边调整'这一传统被 binary continue/stop 掩盖的能力维度显式化。属于 full-duplex voice agent 评测方法学资产，对 aiutil 的 agent eval 路线有间接价值。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 Duplex Cue 是否公开。

papers.title: Type Diversity Enables Transformers to Generalise Compositionally
papers.abstract: Compositional generalisation has been divided into lexical and structural generalisation. Previous work has found that structural generalisation is harder than lexical for Transformers. We propose that this difference is not inherent to Transformers, but due to the high diversity of lexical types and low diversity of structural types in the specific datasets of these previous works. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.13144v1）：Type Diversity Enables Transformers to Generalise Compositionally 提出'lexical vs structural 难度差不是 Transformer 固有属性，而是数据集的 type diversity 不均造成'——把组合泛化问题归因到数据构造层面的多样性而非架构限制。属于 Transformer 组合泛化 / in-context learning 的数据治理视角资产，对 context-engineering 路线有间接方法学价值（提示在合成任务设计时要平衡 lexical / structural type diversity）。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 确认 ablation 是否开源。

papers.abstract: When providing forecasted probabilities with a predictive model, the ideal model offers perfect calibration: the true probability of the outcome (i.e., the probability that $Y=1$) exactly matches the forecasted probability $f(X)$. papers.title: CMA-OT: Hierarchical Expert Supervision for Dance-to-Music Generation
papers.abstract: Dance-to-music (D2M) generation aims to synthesize music that is rhythmically and stylistically aligned with dance videos.
